description: Henry adjusts to living under Ed's roof while work, dating, family history and neighborhood politics repeatedly expose how differently father and son approach almost everything.

s01e01.description: After losing his writing job, Henry moves back in with his blunt, impossible-to-ignore father Ed and discovers that temporary help comes with permanent commentary.

s01e02.description: Henry installs wireless Internet against Ed's wishes, turning a basic household upgrade into a battle over who controls the house.

s01e03.description: A dispute over whether Ed should apologize for getting a DMV worker fired reopens Henry's resentment about how his parents' marriage ended.

s01e04.description: Henry and Ed go on a double date, only for Ed to learn that Henry's date is not interested and try to spare him the humiliation.

s01e05.description: Ed tries to teach Henry not to borrow his clothes and accidentally creates a larger mess by giving away Henry's jacket.

s01e06.description: Henry publishes a story about Ed that embarrasses his father, while Vince and Bonnie attempt to attach themselves to a fashionable new couple.

s01e07.description: Ed's stubborn approach to a neighborhood dog dispute clashes with Henry's efforts to handle the situation more diplomatically.

s01e08.description: Henry and Ed collide over their definitions of masculinity as family advice turns a personal problem into a public competition.

s01e09.description: A well-intended attempt to help someone through a difficult situation becomes another argument over Ed's brutally practical way of showing concern.

s01e10.description: Henry attempts to negotiate peace in a family dispute, only to discover that Ed treats compromise as merely another form of combat.

s01e11.description: A family dinner becomes a minefield when new romantic connections and old Goodson habits collide around the same table.

s01e12.description: Ed's interference in Henry's personal life escalates while Vince and Bonnie pursue another scheme meant to improve their future.

s01e13.description: Henry and Vince compare their experiences of Ed as a father, turning sibling rivalry into a referendum on who actually had it worse.

s01e14.description: Ed fights the homeowners' association over the height of his corn and decides the logical response is to run for president himself.

s01e15.description: Ed's new role in neighborhood politics collides with his pursuit of Rosemary while Henry and Vince hold a ridiculous mustache-growing contest.

s01e16.description: Ed becomes jealous when a wealthy rival competes for Rosemary's attention, while Vince and Bonnie receive an unexpected fertility-related offer.

s01e17.description: A neighborhood burglar prompts Ed to insist on armed protection while Rosemary objects, and Vince and Bonnie seek help at a fertility clinic.

s01e18.description: Henry's new girlfriend seems strangely familiar to Ed, raising an awkward question about their past while Vince and Bonnie enter reality television.
